column1: # cells.tsv - explicit growth cells ([GROWTH-SWEEP]). One row per cell SERIES; the n column is a
# comma list, one cell per size. Pattern = pre + unit*n + mid + unit2*n + post, units joined by
# sep; `{i}` = the unit's index, `{j}` = index+1, `{n}` = n. `-` is the empty string.
# Columns (TAB): id family pre unit sep mid unit2 post n stack raise kind expect limit pair red
#   stack  budget (limits.md 3.10 thread) | main (the process's own 8 MB stack)
#   raise  1 = lift the emitted-size caps (reach every pass) | 0 = shipped caps
#   (no features / engine columns: every row runs `all` features, engine 0)
#   kind   stability | limit (a closed set, no default; owner ruling limit-test-criteria, 2026-11-21)
#          stability: sized PAST the named limit; expect refuse:SUBSTR (that limit's diagnostic)
#          limit:     sized JUST BEFORE it (the largest n that compiles, found by bisection);
#                     expect compile, and its matcher must run
#   expect comma list: compile | compile:norun | refuse:SUBSTRING (the diagnostic names the limit)
#   limit  the limit the cell sits just before (limit) or past (stability); a pair names ONE limit
#   pair   `spine/fam` ...: the id a limit cell shares with its stability twin(s) across the same
#          limit; `none=REASON` = no twin (REASON a key of UNPAIRED_REASONS in run_growth.py; `-` is a table error)
#   red    `ID:KIND`: the known issue and the ONE failure kind it takes (CRASH, TIMEOUT, RUNAWAY,
#          ERROR, refused, BUILD, MATCHER or compiled); a failure of another kind FAILS, and a pass fails the sweep (ratchet)
# compile:norun=NAME (limit cells only): a NAMED exception (run_growth.py NORUN_EXCEPTIONS; owner ruling
# limit-cell-matcher-cost, 2026-11-21): the cell must compile but its matcher is NOT built. At the NFA-state and
# VM-node edges (emit caps lifted, raise 1) the emitted C is tens of MB and gcc -O0 needs 10 minutes and 3.4 GB
# (25 MB measured on z_cls 131069). The runner prints the count per name (15 rows here: 13 plus `cnt` and
# `cnt_nest`; the matrix `+` edge cells of plus_edges.tsv add 92 under the same name). The SHIPPED-cap edges that build do run:
# alt_lit, alt_cap_emit, cat_grp_emit, named_emit (emit-code cap, raise 0) and lit_ship, anchors_ship (the NFA edge
# at shipped caps). Not reachable at shipped caps: z_b z_look z_nlook z_lookb z_cilook crash (K148) between
# n=8000 (compiles) and n=16000, before any size cap refuses; z_cls cat_ncgrp uni exceed 3 GB (K150) near 8000
# The memory-family compile cells (lm_cat, lm_cls, lm_alt2: 4 cells) are STABILITY cells past
# PCREC_MAX_VM_EMIT_CODE_BYTES: K150's memory runaway starts near N=4,770 (3 GB), before the cap (about
# N=7,700) can be approached, so no "just before" cell exists for them.
# The limit cells' sizes (2026-11-21, grow4; bisected with the default build, 1 unit past = refused):
#   (raise 0 edges, bisected the same way, with a main(); limit n / twin n: alt_cap_emit 799 / 802, cat_grp_emit 1007 / 1009,
#     named_emit 990 / 993 (emit code 500,000 bytes), lit_ship 131069 / 131070, anchors_ship 131070 / 131071 (NFA states))
#     raise 0): alt_lit 70657 (a limit cell's artifact carries a main(), which counts; its stability twin has none and
#     is refused from 70773).  The empty (`(?:)`) and inl (`(?i)(?-i)`) spine families are ORDINARY stability cells at
#     the SHIPPED limits (raise 0, 1,000,000 units): PASS = the emitted-code cap refuses them (5.0 MB / 11.0 MB of C
#     against 500,000); K156 closed as not a defect, the caps-lifted variants dropped (review r74 VERDICT-1).
#   count limits (bisected 2026-11-21, one unit past = refused): cnt `(?:ab){2,5}` x 9362 / 9363 (NFA states, raise 1);
#     cnt_nest 10 / 11 nested `(?:...){2,3}` (NFA states, raise 1); calls 14 / 15 chained subroutine calls (emitted code cap, raise 0, with main;
#     16 and up are refused by the same cap).
